stories.title: North Bengaluru shifts from periphery to hub
stories.summary: North Bengaluru is transitioning from a peripheral extension to a primary residential and employment destination. The region is leveraging airport infrastructure and aerospace manufacturing to drive growth. The Kempegowda International Airport remains the foundational driver of this transformation, encouraging business and hospitality development across the area.

stories.title: Telangana faces scrutiny over public land sales
stories.summary: Telangana is pursuing an aggressive land monetization strategy, including a proposed 386-acre auction in Miyapur estimated to generate 40,000 crore rupees. The plan has triggered political opposition and demands for a probe into historical commercial allotments. Public asset disposal remains a point of contention for the state.

stories.title: Real estate sentiment recovers as cities diverge
stories.summary: The Knight Frank to NAREDCO Real Estate Sentiment Index rose to 56 in the third quarter of 2026, up from 48. While developers and investors report renewed optimism, the recovery remains uneven across cities. Affordability and rising construction costs continue to temper the broader market rebound.

stories.title: India office occupancy projected to reach 89.5 percent
stories.summary: India's office market occupancy is expected to rise to 89.5 percent by March 2028, up from 88 percent in September 2026. Global Capability Centres are projected to account for nearly half of the annual net absorption. Vacancy rates are anticipated to decline across five major markets.

stories.title: Global Capability Centres to drive office demand
stories.summary: Global Capability Centres are expected to account for 45 to 50 percent of net office absorption in India during 2027-28, according to ICRA. With demand matching new supply, national office occupancy is projected to reach 89.5 percent by March 2028. The centres remain a primary catalyst for growth.

stories.title: ICRA forecasts office space demand growth
stories.summary: Global Capability Centres are poised to drive nearly half of India's office space demand in 2027-28, according to a report by ICRA. The rating agency expects these centres to support higher occupancy levels across major commercial markets. Net office absorption is projected at 62 to 64 million square feet.

stories.title: Brigade Enterprises shares gain up to 7% as real estate developer sells homes worth Rs 1,600 crore in... - Moneycontrol.
Brigade Enterprises shares rise on project updates
stories.summary: Brigade Enterprises shares climbed 7 percent after the developer recorded 1,600 crore rupees in sales during the launch weekend of its Brigade Autograph project. The company also acquired a 2.25-acre land parcel in Hyderabad. The stock reached a high of 620.15 rupees following the announcements.

stories.title: UAE vs India Real Estate: Where Can Your Property Investment Earn More? - NDTV
Anthropic’s New Millionaires Turbocharge San Francisco’s Red-Hot Housing Market - WSJ
New home sales rise as mortgage rates dip
stories.summary: New home sales increased 7.5 percent year-over-year in October as mortgage rates dropped to 7.21 percent. Despite the uptick, year-to-date totals remain lower than in 2025. Economic volatility and potential new tariffs leave the future direction of mortgage rates uncertain.

stories.title: New home sales reach 2026 high
stories.summary: New home sales reached a seasonally adjusted annual pace of 701,000 in October, a 14.2 percent increase from September. The median sales price fell 3.2 percent compared to last year. Builders are lowering prices to meet demand, though year-to-date sales remain 3 percent below 2025 levels.

stories.title: US new home sales surge to 10-month high in October - Reuters
New home sales surge in October
stories.summary: Sales of new single-family homes rose 14.2 percent to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 701,000 units in October, the highest level since December 2025. Builders cut prices to attract buyers despite high mortgage rates. September sales figures were revised downward to 614,000 units.

stories.title: Price cuts drive new home sales surge
stories.summary: New home sales hit 701,000 in October, a 14.2 percent increase from September. The median sales price dropped to 391,300 dollars, 3.2 percent lower than in October 2025. The growth was driven by a 36.2 percent surge in the South, while Northeast sales plummeted 40 percent.

stories.title: Aparna Constructions announces expansion
stories.summary: Aparna Constructions is set to invest 1,825 crore rupees into two new residential projects located in Hyderabad and Bengaluru. The company continues to expand its footprint in these markets as part of its ongoing development strategy.

stories.title: Brigade acquires land parcel in Secunderabad for INR 1000 cr premium residential development - Travel Trends Today
Primus Senior Living partners for Bengaluru project
stories.summary: Primus Senior Living has partnered with Mana Skanda to develop a senior living project in Bengaluru. The project represents an investment of 375 crore rupees. The collaboration aims to address the growing demand for dedicated senior housing facilities in the city.

stories.title: UnitedHealth takes 4.3 lakh sq ft office on lease in Chennai
stories.summary: Optum Health and Technology India and Optum Global Solutions India have leased 4.3 lakh sq ft across 10 floors in Chennai. The lease at Embassy Office Parks REIT’s development includes a 15 percent rental escalation every three years. The rent commencement date is set for June 2026.

stories.title: Coimbatore identified as potential office market
stories.summary: Coimbatore hosts an estimated 660,000 professionals, positioning it as a talent hub for companies seeking alternatives to expensive metropolitan markets. While emerging markets currently hold less than one-tenth of India's Grade A office inventory, the city's industrial and technology ecosystem is being eyed for future infrastructure growth.

stories.title: Dubai office rents climb as vacancy hits 3.9 percent
stories.summary: Prime office rents in Dubai have risen 13.7 percent since January, with vacancy rates tightening to 3.9 percent. An annual budget of AED 500,000 now secures 37 percent less Grade A space than it did at the end of 2023. More choice is expected by 2027.

stories.summary: Mehul R Thakkar is a Mumbai-based journalist who closely tracks the city’s ever-evolving real estate landscape. stories.summary: Sometimes you have to mine a lot of rocks before you find a sparkly diamond. In a manner of speaking, the same goes for finding medical spaces throughout Arizona. As Arizona’s population increases, demand for outpatient healthcare facilities rises. But finding financially viable, optimal locations continues to prove challenging. Could

stories.title: Blackstone-backed developer eyes Minnesota data center
stories.summary: Link Logistics has presented preliminary plans for a $4.8 billion data center campus on a former BAE Systems site in Fridley, Minnesota. The proposed Project Sunflower would span 252 megawatts. The city has yet to receive an official application for the industrial site redevelopment.

stories.title: Data center suppliers drive industrial leasing growth
stories.summary: Companies supplying data centers accounted for 14 percent of all U.S. industrial space leased last quarter, up from under 3 percent in 2022 and 2023. The 50 million square foot surge in demand is largely driven by the ongoing AI build-out and related equipment manufacturing requirements.

stories.title: Japanese developers invest in Hokkaido data center
stories.summary: Daibiru, Sankei Building, and Osaka Gas Urban Development are investing in a 15MW data center in Ishikari City. The facility, managed by Tokyu Land Corporation, is powered by local renewable energy. The project marks the first data center investment for both Osaka Gas and Daibiru.

stories.title: Blackstone's Link Logistics eyes data center outside Minneapolis, Minnesota
stories.summary: Blackstone-backed logistics real estate firm Link Logistics is potentially planning a data center in Minneapolis, Minnesota. BizJournal reports that Link Logistics is exploring a potential $4.8 billion development at 4800 East River Road NE in the Fridley area of Minneapolis. The planned data centers, known as Project Sunflower, could total

stories.title: Mexico shifts data center supply chain toward local production
stories.summary: Mexico is integrating early-stage design and local manufacturing into its data center supply chain to mitigate equipment delays. Nearshoring and USMCA rules are accelerating domestic capacity. Long-term competitiveness remains dependent on aligning technical certification standards and specialized engineering training across the region.

stories.title: Mexico faces fiber capacity constraints for hyperscale demand
stories.summary: Panelists at the Mexico Data Center Summit 2026 noted that current cross-border fiber capacity is insufficient for AI demand. While the TIKVA route is 86 percent complete, experts warn that redundancy is failing as routes converge. Permitting remains the primary obstacle to expanding inland distribution.

stories.title: Industrial estates in Southeast Asia see tenant shift
stories.summary: Greater Jakarta industrial estates ended the third quarter 91.6 percent occupied, with new land acquisitions dominated by fiber-optic makers, steel plants, and data center builders. The region is seeing a quiet transition as industries requiring significant power and floor space replace previous, unnamed tenants.

stories.title: Larsen Baker and EPX acquire Tucson industrial property
stories.summary: Larsen Baker and EPX Construction Partners have acquired a fully leased industrial building and development land in Tucson for $6.3 million. The deal marks the first Tucson investment for the El Paso-based EPX. The two firms closed the transaction as equal partners on October 30.

Cabinet approves ₹2,014 crore greenfield airport at Doloo in Assam
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a new greenfield airport in Doloo to address spatial constraints at the existing civil enclave in Silchar. The project, to be developed by the Airports Authority of India, will feature a terminal capable of handling 800 passengers during peak hours.

stories.title: Mumbai Metro Line 11 Survey Begins in Mumbai - Urban Acres
Cyberabad Municipal Corporation to build twin-tower headquarters worth Rs 169 crore
stories.summary: The Cyberabad Municipal Corporation has invited tenders for a new twin-tower headquarters at Izzath Nagar. The complex is designed to be a net-zero green building featuring renewable energy systems and water conservation measures. The corporation currently operates from a temporary office space.

stories.title: Cyberabad civic body plans ₹169-crore net-zero headquarters on the edge of Kotha Kunta lake
stories.summary: The Cyberabad Municipal Corporation is planning a 2,41,540 square foot twin-tower complex at Izzath Nagar. The project includes a council hall, an integrated command centre, and office space for various departments. It is situated on 4.11 acres of land directly adjoining Kotha Kunta Lake.

stories.title: Cyberabad Civic Body Plans Rs. 169 Crore Headquarters - INDToday
CMC calls tenders for Rs 169 cr twin-tower office at Izzath Nagar
stories.summary: The Cyberabad Municipal Corporation has invited e-tenders for its permanent headquarters at Izzath Nagar. The project is estimated at Rs 169 crore and will be built on 4.11 acres of land. The corporation is currently working out of a temporary building near HITEX.

stories.title: Government moves to implement Ring Road 5 construction in Hanoi
stories.summary: Standing Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc has signed a resolution to implement the construction of Ring Road 5 in the Hanoi Capital Region. The project follows an investment policy approved by the National Assembly in August 2026 to ensure connectivity across the region.

TG RERA penalizes Auro Realty for unregistered project marketing
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulation Authority has imposed a Rs 25 lakh penalty on Auro Realty for advertising its 'Auro Sapphire' project in Kondapur without registration. The proposed development includes four towers and over 1,300 residential units with prices starting from Rs 2 crore.

stories.title: Aliens Developers fined ₹2 crore by Telangana RERA
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority fined Aliens Developers ₹2 crore for collecting 38% of a flat's price without a registered sale agreement. The developer's draft contract offered buyers significantly lower compensation for delays than the amount required under state rules.

stories.title: TG RERA orders ELV Projects to complete amenities within six months
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has given ELV Projects six months to provide water, power backup, and operational lifts at its Adibatla project. Buyers reported lacking municipal water and facing power cuts despite paying for connections. The developer has yet to obtain an occupancy certificate.

stories.title: Forest Service rule change aims to ease affordable housing on federal land
stories.summary: The U.S. Forest Service is loosening leasing rules for administrative sites to help local governments develop affordable housing. Projects have been proposed in several mountain resort communities where land is limited. Some developments have already stalled despite the 2018 authorization to use these sites.

stories.title: Mamdani wins against landlords in New York rent freeze lawsuit: ‘Housing is not a luxury’ - The Guardian
Judge upholds New York City rent freeze
stories.summary: A Manhattan judge has dismissed a lawsuit from landlords challenging the city's rent freeze on roughly 1 million rent-stabilized apartments. The court ruled that the Rent Guidelines Board acted within its authority when it voted to freeze rents on one- and two-year leases this summer.

stories.title: Door and Hardware Federation responds to construction products reform
stories.summary: The Door and Hardware Federation has commented on the government's white paper regarding construction product regulations. The industry body emphasized the need for clear and deliverable standards for manufacturers and installers following the government's response to public consultations on testing, certification, and regulatory oversight.

stories.title: New Hampshire construction industry reports rising costs from federal rules
stories.summary: Developers in New Hampshire report that the Build America, Buy America requirement is causing construction delays and budget overruns. One housing project is reportedly $2 million over budget as developers struggle to comply with the federal mandate while attempting to increase the state's affordable housing supply.

stories.title: Power Ministry proposes net metering charges and mandatory battery storage
stories.summary: The Union Power Ministry has proposed new charges for rooftop solar users and mandatory energy storage for certain renewable installations. The draft amendments aim to improve the financial health of power distribution companies and manage grid challenges resulting from increased renewable energy integration.

stories.title: Hunt Capital Partners and partners close financing for Denton development
stories.summary: Hunt Capital Partners, O-SDA Industries and Denton Affordable Housing Corporation have closed $22 million in financing for McAdams Haven. The project will provide 84 furnished studio apartments for households with special needs, including veterans and survivors of domestic abuse. The development is located in Denton, Texas.

NETSTREIT reports third quarter results
stories.summary: NETSTREIT reported $66.3 million in total revenue and $8.5 million in net income for the third quarter of 2026. The company acquired 79 properties for $264 million while maintaining its full-year guidance. A $400 million delayed draw term loan remains unfunded.

AI-staged listings raise concerns over transparency
stories.summary: Real estate brokers are increasingly using generative AI to virtually stage vacant properties. While virtual staging is common, some listings now use AI to remove physical defects like water stains or damaged flooring. The practice has been coined housefishing, as digital edits improve the home's appearance.

stories.title: RETCON 2027 moves to Fort Lauderdale
stories.summary: Real estate technology conference RETCON will hold its 2027 event in Fort Lauderdale from March 7-9. Organizers selected the location due to the region's status as a fast-growing real estate market. The event began as a digital gathering in 2020 and now focuses on in-person industry networking.

stories.title: CBRE study finds CRE departments planning reorganizations
stories.summary: A study by the CBRE Institute reports that 40 percent of corporate real estate departments are considering major team reorganizations. Leaders cited AI, economic pressure and mergers as the primary forces driving these changes. The primary mission of these departments remains business enablement.

stories.summary: We live in a world built for speed. Think noise, visuals and messages designed to be consumed in three seconds or less. stories.title: Douglas Elliman and Numerator announce leadership moves
stories.summary: Douglas Elliman has added luxury advisor Sebastian Lopera to The Katzen Team. Meanwhile, former Zonda chief economist Ali Wolf has joined Numerator in the same capacity. Wolf departs Zonda after an 11-year tenure to pursue a new opportunity.

stories.summary: This weekend, as families and friends gather together to enjoy the traditional turkey, dressing, cranberries and the rest of the trimmings along with non-stop football, it’s easy to forget the sheer amount of everyday abundance that we have in this country. During the World Cup, first-time visitors marveled at the

stories.title: What the Pilgrims wanted in a home and what they got
stories.summary: Buying a new home and moving can be stressful. Buying without an agent and moving yourself with a rental truck would make it much more undesirable. But crossing the Atlantic with your whole family and church congregation in a square-rigged sailboat to pick out your home on your own? Yikes.

Metso shifts focus to recycled aggregates
stories.summary: Metso is repositioning recycled aggregates from a peripheral activity to a strategic growth area within its crushing and screening business. The company says recycling is becoming central to its product development and plant design as tighter quarry permitting and resource pressure reshape the global aggregates industry.

stories.title: Calix and Ambuja Cements advance Indian project
stories.summary: Calix is advancing a partnership with Ambuja Cements to develop a commercial-scale demonstration project at the Sanghi cement plant in India. An engineering study is underway, with the partners targeting a Go/No-Go decision during the 2027 financial year to test a replicable pathway for commercial deployment.

stories.title: Four companies selected for rare earth magnet scheme
stories.summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries has selected Coal India, ReNew, Prozeal Green Energy, and Midwest Energy under its INR 7,280 crore rare earth permanent magnet manufacturing scheme. A fifth beneficiary is expected to be announced soon for the government-backed production initiative.

stories.title: Toulouse project recovers 200,000 tonnes of materials
stories.summary: An EU-funded construction recycling initiative in Toulouse, France, has reported the reuse and recycling of more than 200,000 tonnes of construction materials and waste. The project aims to demonstrate the potential for circular economy practices within the building sector.

stories.title: Cladding systems market projected to reach $91.98 billion
stories.summary: The global cladding systems market is projected to grow from $73.13 billion in 2026 to $91.98 billion by 2031. Analysts cite rapid urbanization and population growth as primary drivers for the 4.69% annual growth rate expected over the five-year period.

stories.title: Metstrade 2026 reports record attendance
stories.summary: Metstrade 2026 drew 1,800 exhibitors to RAI Amsterdam, filling all 13 of the venue halls. Over 19,400 visitors attended from 144 countries, making more than 31,000 visits over three days. The event expanded its floor plan to accommodate more suppliers and construction materials exhibitors.

stories.title: Shalimar Paints receives listing approval for QIP shares
stories.summary: Shalimar Paints has received approval from BSE and NSE to list 5.19 crore equity shares issued through a Qualified Institutions Placement. The shares were allotted at 77 rupees each, and trading commences November 26. Seven funds acquired 75% of the issue size.

stories.title: Breedon Group earnings hit by energy costs
stories.summary: Breedon Group expects full-year underlying earnings at the lower end of market expectations. The company reported that rising energy costs became harder to recover through pricing late in the construction season, despite revenue growth driven by UK pricing and improved operations in Ireland.

Suzlon Energy to build smart blade factory in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Suzlon Energy will set up a 1 GW smart blade manufacturing facility in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. The project is expected to create over 1,000 skilled jobs, with the company stating that 80 percent of the employment will come from rural communities.

stories.title: Greensteel Australia partners with Envision Energy
stories.summary: Greensteel Australia has enlisted Envision Energy for a planned 400MW green hydrogen plant. The developer says the first all-electric phase of its steel project is due to start operations in 2028, though a final investment decision on the hydrogen facility remains pending.

stories.title: COP31 climate finance negotiations stall
stories.summary: The breakdown of negotiations at COP31 in Antalya has highlighted divisions over fossil-fuel transition pathways and financing obligations. While countries remain split on the resources required to implement climate commitments, the question of how developing economies should secure reliable energy systems received little attention.

stories.title: Delhi to install 540 public EV chargers
stories.summary: The Delhi government is setting up 540 EV chargers across 180 locations to support electric vehicle adoption. The nodal agency Transco has begun appointing operators to manage the infrastructure under the PM e-drive scheme, using a charger configuration approved by the Ministry of Heavy Industries.

stories.title: Green cement market forecast to reach $74.4 billion
stories.summary: The global green cement market is expected to reach $37.7 billion in 2026 and grow to $74.4 billion by 2033. The sector is banking on industrial byproducts and alternative binders to lower the environmental impact of traditional cement manufacturing.

stories.title: Woodcircles project targets circular construction
stories.summary: The Woodcircles project is working to connect reclaimed timber and reversible building systems with existing industrial value chains. The initiative aims to scale circular construction by integrating reuse practices into the manufacturers and working methods that already supply the construction sector.

stories.title: Digital Product Passport guide for real estate
stories.summary: The Digital Product Passport is a central building block of the EU Green Deal. The passport is intended to serve market surveillance by providing information obligations for products, with the European real estate sector now evaluating its relevance for building materials and circularity.

stories.title: Home prices fell in 76 major US markets
stories.summary: Home prices declined year-on-year in 76 of the 300 largest US real estate markets in October, according to ResiClub data. While the number of markets with falling prices has increased since August, national housing prices still rose by 0.7 percent. The pace of growth is slowing.

stories.title: Home prices fall in 76 of 300 major US markets
stories.summary: Home prices fell year-over-year in 76 of the 300 largest US housing markets in October, up from 54 markets in August. Nationally, prices rose 0.7 percent, though high mortgage rates threaten to offset buyer savings. The count of declining markets remains below the 89 recorded in March.

stories.title: US Mortgage Rates Fall for Fifth Time in Six Weeks, Still Top 7% - Bloomberg
Tampa home prices hold steady as sales fall 17 percent
stories.summary: Tampa home prices remained stable in October, with the median single-family sale price rising 0.7 percent to $425,500. Closings fell 17.4 percent as the buyer pool shrank. Sellers are maintaining last year's prices, but the market is loosening as buyers take more time to decide.

stories.title: Dallas home sales fall 16 percent in October
stories.summary: Single-family home closings in the Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington metro area fell 16 percent in October. The median sale price dropped 2 percent to $381,000 compared to a year earlier. Sales for the first ten months of 2026 are down 1 percent, leaving buyers with more choice.

stories.title: Houston home sales drop 15 percent in October
stories.summary: Houston saw its fewest October home sales in a decade, with closings falling 14.9 percent. The median price slipped 3 percent to $320,000 as supply reached its highest level since 2012. Buyers are increasingly focused on monthly payments, and sellers are finding fewer offers.

stories.title: Charlotte home sales fall 19 percent in October
stories.summary: Charlotte existing home sales dropped 19 percent in October, while the median price fell 2 percent to $416,355. Inventory rose 18.4 percent, providing buyers with more options and time. Sellers are still targeting last year's prices, but they are working with a smaller audience.

stories.title: Seattle home prices fall 6.4 percent in October
stories.summary: Seattle house prices fell 6.4 percent to a median of $982,500 in October, while condo prices dropped 10.7 percent. Citywide sales cooled, with total closings down 17.6 percent compared to last year. Buyers now have more inventory to consider, particularly in the condo market.

stories.title: European Commission warns of rising Portuguese house prices
stories.summary: The European Commission noted that property prices in Portugal rose 17.6 percent in 2025, the second-highest increase in the European Union. The commission monitors affordability by comparing earnings against rent and price growth. The average EU house price increase was 5.5 percent during the same period.
